versions.content: Error values naming convention All AUTOSAR Basic Software Modules shall apply the following naming rules for all error values: Error values shall have only CAPITAL LETTERS Naming convention: FRTRCV_E_<ERRORNAME> If <ERRORNAME> consists of several words, they shall be separated by underscores The error shows to which module it belongs.
